answer: No single identity may earn more than 2852 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. Because the horizon cap is applied per key at the mesa settlement, the thread audit exposes each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. That forces each duplicate self to stay small, which multiplies the fixed burns of running them while capping the upside of each. That is 29 dollars per alias.
